context:
# Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

Retrieval-augmented generation grounds a model's answer in documents fetched at question time. A retriever selects passages from a corpus; the generator is prompted with the question and those passages and is expected to answer only from them. RAG reduces unsupported claims because every statement can be traced to a source.

# Evaluating RAG systems

A RAG system is evaluated in two parts. Context quality asks whether the retrieved passages contain what is needed (context precision and recall). Answer quality asks whether the answer is faithful to the retrieved passages (faithfulness, no claims beyond them) and relevant to the question. Scoring the two separately shows whether a bad answer came from retrieval or from generation.
